subject: Post-discovery: schedule TDX + attendee gaps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Thompson <arielle@clearpathsystems.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule TDX + attendee gaps

Hi Arielle — thanks again for a focused call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (TDX) with your infra/ML leads:

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: validate serving latency and cost for Clearpath models at 1–5 RPS and discuss fallbacks/cost controls.
- Key stakeholders to include: your infra lead (Daniel), ML platform engineer, and platform/security for data flows.
- Success criteria: confirm baseline latency SLOs, identify quantization/batching approach, agree mutual action plan for a 30-day POC.

Proposed TDX scope & agenda (60–90m)
- 0–10m: quick objectives + attendee intros
- 10–30m: model & infra constraints (your team walks us through prod topology)
- 30–60m: Redwood demo — serving runtime, batching, KV caching, and quantization tradeoffs
- 60–80m: runbook & fallbacks (SLA/rollout discussion)
- 80–90m: next steps / mutual action plan items

Availability — would any of these windows work for your team (all times PT)?
1) Tue May 14 — 10:00–11:30 PT
2) Wed May 15 — 08:30–10:00 PT
3) Thu May 16 — 13:00–14:30 PT

If none work please propose 1–2 alternatives. Also, can you confirm whether Daniel (CTO/infra) and your ML engineer can attend? I’ve attached a draft mutual action plan and a stub agenda for review.

Pre-reads: quick checklist in the MAP shows items we’ll want available (sample model, perf numbers, any infra diagrams).

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots until EOD Monday and then send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: CP-2029-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP), TDX-agenda-draft.pdf (agenda stub)
From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@clearpathsystems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule TDX + attendee gaps

Thanks Ben — good recap. Daniel is on the thread. High-level notes from our side:
- We definitely want Daniel (infra) and our ML platform engineer (Sofia Patel) on the call. I’ve CC'd Daniel above.
- Security will probably need to join part of the discussion; I’ll loop them in if we confirm a slot.

For availability, Wed May 15 at 08:30–10:00 PT works for Daniel and me. Sofia is out the morning of May 14 but available the afternoon of May 16. If you need both Sofia + Daniel together, Thu May 16 13:00–14:30 PT is better.

Can you confirm whether you’ll demo any live perf runs or will it be slides + recorded runs? Also we’ll need a short list of infra artifacts we should have on hand ahead of the TDX (model size, peaking RPS, any network ACL notes).

Thanks — Arielle

Subject: Re: Post-discovery: schedule TDX + attendee gaps

Great — thanks for the fast reply and the attendee clarity. We’ll aim for Thu May 16 13:00–14:30 PT so Sofia and Daniel can both attend.

What we’ll bring:
- Short live perf demo (20–25m) using a small sample model and pre-warmed KV cache; we’ll keep it deterministic but realistic.
- Slides on batching/quantization tradeoffs and a short runbook for rollouts and fallbacks.
- A checklist of artifacts we need from you (model artifact link, peak/steady RPS, network egress rules).

Marcus — can you own the live perf run and ensure we have a short script we can run from our sandbox? Priyom — can you send the calendar invite once Arielle confirms attendee names and include the MAP + agenda link?

Arielle — attaching the MAP and agenda again; I’ll add the TDX block to my calendar tentatively and will send a formal invite once Priyom posts it. If Security needs to join for the last 20 minutes we can add them to the invite.

Ben

Ben — I’m on for Thu May 16 13:00–14:30 PT. I’ll prepare:
- 20m live perf run (small model, fixed prompt set) with token-level latency reporting and a quick cost estimate for the configuration we show.
- Notes on batching knobs we’ll demonstrate and the KV cache warmup sequence.
- Runbook snippet for rollback/fallbacks and a short list of infra checks we’ll ask the Clearpath team to provide before the session (model size, expected peak RPS, network egress/IP ranges).

I’ll upload the perf script and a link to the sandbox run by EOD Wed (14 May). Priyom — if you can push the calendar invite and include the shared drive MAP + agenda links that’ll be perfect.
